_about: Health concepts a speaker may name, with curated trigger words (Algerian Darija as Whisper writes it, Arabic, French). asset_lib.py uses them two ways: (1) the triggers are merged into the keywords of the pictures listed in id/assets (or linked to the concept with setmany), so matching never depends on GPT's keywords alone; (2) when the speaker says a trigger and no picture covers it, the concept is reported as MISSING so you ask the user to upload a picture for it; only if they ask, `fill` has GPT draw it (prompt built from the style guide template with subject/inner/tube for glossy, subject/crop/marks|cutaway/action for flat, or a full prompt; a concept with no subject can only be an upload). An uploaded picture gets a concept's triggers when setmany names it: concept = <id>. Keep triggers specific: a bare word that also means something else in a honey ad (البرد, الضغط, الحرارة, كيلو, الدم) makes false hits.

concepts.prompt: Minimal flat health icon illustration: side-profile silhouette of a woman's upper body breathing in deeply and calmly, chin slightly raised, eyes closed, chest open, facing right, cropped at the chest. One solid vivid orange (#FB7201) shape with a soft gradient from lighter orange at the top to deeper orange (#E85A01) at the bottom left, smooth matte finish, no outline. A few thin tapered dark brown (#632302) strokes mark the ear, the closed eye and the neck line. Three soft curved orange airflow lines flow toward the nose. Isolated on a transparent background, no shadow, no text, no other colors.

concepts.action: Three short orange dashes radiate from the mouth.

Minimal flat health icon illustration: side-profile silhouette of a man's upper body sneezing, head tilted forward, eyes squeezed shut, one hand raised near the nose, facing right, cropped at the chest. One solid vivid orange (#FB7201) shape with a soft gradient from lighter orange at the top to deeper orange (#E85A01) at the bottom left, smooth matte finish, no outline. A few thin tapered dark brown (#632302) strokes mark the ear, the squeezed eye, the neck line and the finger creases. A small burst of short orange dashes and dots sprays forward from the nose and mouth. Overlapping parts are separated by a thin gap of empty background. Isolated on a transparent background, no shadow, no text, no other colors.
